name: luna
description: Modular agent framework built on Effect with full Claude Agent SDK parity

scripts.build: bun run --filter '@luna/core' build && bun run --filter '@luna/ui-web' build && bun run --filter '@luna/ui-moon-tauri' build -- --config '{"bundle":{"createUpdaterArtifacts":false}}'
scripts.test:bun: bun test packages/core packages/observability-tools packages/memory packages/vault packages/channels/test/dedup-sqlite.test.ts packages/mcp-servers
scripts.test:all: bun run test && bun run test:bun
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/agent-cli/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/ui-web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui-shared-solid/tsconfig.json
